overview.headline: Lee Resolution and the move toward American independence in 1776

keyPoints.point: Richard Henry Lee introduced a resolution proposing independence on June 7 1776 under Virginia instruction
keyPoints.quote: On June 7, 1776, Richard Henry Lee introduced a resolution "that these united colonies are and of right ought to be free and independent states,"

keyPoints.point: The Lee Resolution contained three parts including declaration of independence foreign alliances and a plan for confederation
keyPoints.quote: The Lee Resolution contained three parts: a declaration of independence, a call to form foreign alliances, and "a plan for confederation."

keyPoints.point: On June 11 1776 Congress appointed three concurrent committees to draft declaration alliances and confederation plans
keyPoints.quote: On June 11, 1776, the Congress appointed three concurrent committees in response to the Lee Resolution: one to draft a declaration of independence,

keyPoints.point: Approval was deferred until July when Congress adopted the declaration part whose words echoed in the Declaration of Independence
The document shows affirmative votes of 12 colonies listed while New York cast no vote until July 9 1776
keyPoints.quote: The document seen here shows the vote on the Lee Resolution — the affirmative votes of 12 colonies are listed at the right.

keyPoints.point: The plan for making treaties was not approved until September of 1776 and confederation was delayed until November of the following year
keyPoints.quote: The plan for making treaties was not approved until September of 1776; the plan of confederation was delayed until November of 1777.

keyTerms.gloss: elected delegates forming the governing body that acted for the union during the Revolution
keyTerms.quote: The colonists elected delegates to attend a Continental Congress that eventually became the governing body of the union during the Revolution.

keyTerms.gloss: proposal containing three parts for declaration of independence and alliances and confederation
keyTerms.quote: The Lee Resolution contained three parts: a declaration of independence, a call to form foreign alliances, and "a plan for confederation."

keyTerms.gloss: colonial assembly that gave instruction for Lee to propose independence
keyTerms.quote: acting under the instruction of the Virginia Convention.

keyTerms.gloss: form of union to prepare and digest among the colonies
keyTerms.quote: and a third to "prepare and digest the form of a confederation."

keyTerms.gloss: statement whose words echoed the Lee Resolution declaration
keyTerms.quote: The words of the Lee Resolution are echoed in the Declaration of Independence.
